blocks.text: Day 9 · Fly from Zorg en Hoop airport in Paramaribo to the Kabalebo airstrip, about one hour west, and check in at the resort beside it. After lunch, an introductory forest walk on one of the trails (Beechcraft trail, the BWKW rapids, or from the foot of Misty Mountain to Sand Creek), combined with a dugout-canoe trip and a dip in the river.
